business: yerby, a cold-brewed sparkling yerba mate drink in a 330 ml can, launching in Czechia
target: Czech adults aged 18 to 40 who either drink energy drinks like Red Bull or Monster a few times a week, or live an active, health-conscious lifestyle (regular sport, healthy eating, reading labels) and want cleaner, natural energy (all amounts, including your yearly income, are in Czech crowns, CZK, not dollars)

segments.name: Active health-focused adult (sport most weeks, eats clean)

behaviours.name: Daily energy-drink regular
behaviours.how: Drinks a Monster or Red Bull most days, usually grabbed at a petrol station, Albert or Tesco on the way.

behaviours.name: Value buyer
behaviours.how: Buys Semtex, Big Shock or Monster 4-packs on offer; price per can matters more than the brand.

behaviours.name: Sugar-free switcher
behaviours.how: Already moved to Zero or Ultra versions and reads the label for sugar and sweeteners.

behaviours.name: Gym and fitness
behaviours.how: Drinks pre-workout or energy cans around training, buys from fitness e-shops like Vilgain or GymBeam.

behaviours.name: Health-first label reader
behaviours.how: Checks every ingredient list, avoids additives and sweeteners, shops at health stores and on Rohlík's bio section.

behaviours.name: Outdoor and endurance active
behaviours.how: Runs, cycles or hikes most weekends and drinks coffee, matcha or water rather than energy drinks.

behaviours.name: Trend chaser
behaviours.how: Tries new cans from Rohlík or a café fridge and posts the good ones on Instagram.

behaviours.name: Loyal to one brand
behaviours.how: Has drunk the same energy drink for years and knows exactly how it hits.

behaviours.name: Café and bistro grabber
behaviours.how: Buys drinks out of the fridge at the café or bistro where they get lunch or work.

objections: 55 CZK for 330 ml when a Red Bull is about 45 and a big Monster is about 46
